name: The Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the last days will be marked by a significant increase in knowledge and activity, as Daniel was instructed to seal the book until the time of the end when many will run to and fro. Jesus' teachings point to a time when faith will be tested and questioned, asking whether the Son of Man will find faith upon His return. Observations of daily life, such as the rich giving offerings, also provide insight into the social conditions during these times. These verses collectively highlight the spiritual vigilance and awareness needed as the last days approach.
